Reserved marks have no ticker mapping and do not create watchlist entries or prices.

The catalog is independent of the watchlist and applies to search results, additions, details and editing.

Regenerate assets and Swift mappings with `python3 scripts/update-brand-icons.py`.
Run `python3 scripts/update-brand-icons.py --check` for an offline asset/hash/mapping consistency check.
Source archive URLs, versions and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `catalog.json`.
The importer downloads only missing source archives into the ignored build folder.
No runtime logo requests or packages are used.
